notes.title: "SKY THE SCRAPER" Selected for TGS2025 'Selected Indie 80' Corner
notes.content: [h1]"SKY THE SCRAPER" Selected for TGS2025 'Selected Indie 80' Corner[/h1][h2]Playable Demo Available at Makuhari Messe![/h2][p][/p][p]"SKY THE SCRAPER" is officially announced to participate in Tokyo Game Show 2025 (TGS2025), held at Makuhari Messe from September 25 (Thursday) to September 28 (Sunday), 2025. The game has been selected through a rigorous screening process as one of the 80 titles to be showcased in the "Selected Indie 80" corner. Attendees will find "SKY THE SCRAPER" at its dedicated individual booth within this area, where a playable demo will be available for visitors to try.[/p][p][/p][h3]Exhibition Details[/h3][quote][p][b]Dates:[/b] September 25 (Thursday) - September 28 (Sunday), 2025[/p][p][b]Times:[/b][/p][p]Business Days (September 25 - 26): 10:00 AM - 5:00 PM[/p][p]Public Day (September 27): 9:30 AM - 5:00 PM[/p][p]Public Day (September 28): 9:30 AM - 4:30 PM[/p][p][b]Venue:[/b] Makuhari Messe[/p][p][b]Booth Name:[/b] Ryo Kobuchi[/p][p][b]Location:[/b] Hall 10 | Booth Number E-64[/p][/quote][p][/p][p]We look forward to welcoming you to our booth![/p]

notes.title: Update Patch Released
notes.content:
Thank you for playing SKY THE SCRAPER. We've released a patch to improve overall gameplay experience.

⚙️ Changes & Fixes
[list]
[*] Fixed issues related to conversation events and adjusted the balance of affinity gain
[*] Fixed an issue where the cursor became unresponsive in certain menu screens
[*] Various minor display-related fixes
[/list]

If you notice any issues, please let us know via the forum or on social media.
— The SKY THE SCRAPER Team

notes.title: Update Patch Released
notes.content:
Thank you for playing SKY THE SCRAPER.
We’ve released an update patch addressing progression-related bugs and minor text issues.

⚙️ Fixes and Changes
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where the game could become stuck on the result screen when certain Future Shards were equipped
[*]Fixed an issue on Day 42 of Departure (“The Final Worksite”) where the cursor could become unresponsive after the tutorial guide was displayed
[*]Corrected typos in certain dialogue scenes
[/list]

If you notice any issues or have feedback, please share it with us via the forums or social media.

— The SKY THE SCRAPER Team

notes.title: Update Patch Released
notes.content:
An update patch has been released to adjust game balance and fix several issues.

⚙️ Changes and Fixes
[list]
[*] Drone performance has been nerfed
[*] Fixed a bug in the building stage where strong winds had no effect after detaching from the wall
[*] Expanded the range of the searchlights
[/list]

We will continue improving the game based on your feedback.
If you notice anything or have suggestions, please let us know on the forums or social media.

— SKY THE SCRAPER Team

notes.title: SKY THE SCRAPER will be exhibiting at Taipei Game Show 2025
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44358472/ed4b745d36b499396b1c971498b4bc699c3d1ce1.png[/img]
[h3]HYPER REAL Exhibition Overview[/h3]
[quote=author]●Dates: Thursday, January 23rd to Sunday, January 26th, 2025, 9:00-17:00
●Venue: Taipei Nangang Exhibition Center Hall 1 (TaiNEX 1)
●Booth name: HYPER REAL
●Booth location: BtoC Zone, A23[/quote]

At the booth, we will be exhibiting three games for you to try out: "SAEKO: Giantess Dating Sim", "SKY THE SCRAPER" and "Telebbit". Those who play the games and register them on their wishlist on the spot will receive an original keychain for each game!

In addition, on Saturday and Sunday, we will be holding a time attack challenge for the precision 2D action game "Telebbit". Players who can clear the game within the time limit will receive non-sale original Telebbit merchandise. If you're confident in your skills, please come and try it out! *Novelties are limited in number and will be given away while supplies last.

We look forward to seeing you there!

notes.title: Steam Endless Replayability Fest
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44358472/1dd77228a6ebe4219f216ca5a1afce7ef073f340.png[/img]

[h2][b]Steam Endless Replayability Fest runs 13-20 May! [/b][/h2]
To celebrate, the latest demo version of SKY THE SCRAPER is playable in English on Steam now.
Even if you've played the demo before, enjoy this rogue-like adventure with a major updates.

[list]
[*]Earn money, maintain your body and mind and guide Sky's destiny.
[*]Talk with your parents, landlord, childhood friends and others to develop relationships.
[*]Buy equipments to increase your skills, but be careful not to spend too much money.
[*]Easier-to-understand tutorial.
[/list]
[h3]SKY THE SCRAPER is aiming to be released by the end of 2024[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2387430/SKY_THE_SCRAPER/
